species: Primary hepatocytes extracted from Dyrk1b HepKO mice and Flox controls were transfected with Ad-encoding Flag-FoxO1, and affinity purified. Flag-FoxO1 band was then excised from the Coomassie-stained gel and analyzed by mass spectrometry.

age: All primary mouse hepatocytes used in this study were isolated from 6- to 8-week-old mice following the protocol as previously described.
sex: At weaning, age-matched male mice were grouped by cage according to genotype.
strain: Founder mouse was then crossed with a C57BL/6J mouse to generate Dyrk1b-flox mice.
